Title: The Azure Monitor Logs page now links to the community GitHub repo

Body.Content:
The Azure Monitor Logs page now links to the huge community's GitHub repo in addition to the forum, so you can easily explore hundreds of working examples or consult on how to write your query.

Read more about it on the community blog post.
